instruction.name: pcaddi

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: pcaddi $r12, 1; pcaddi $r13, 1; pcaddi $r14, 1; pcaddi $r15, 1; pcaddi $r16, 1; pcaddi $r17, 1; pcaddi $r18, 1; pcaddi $r19, 1
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --asm 'pcaddi $r12, 1; pcaddi $r13, 1; pcaddi $r14, 1; pcaddi $r15, 1; pcaddi $r16, 1; pcaddi $r17, 1; pcaddi $r18, 1; pcaddi $r19, 1'

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. Throughput only.
